zh: 这个月的健身卡多少钱？
old_en: How much is the gym membership for this month?
new_en: How much is the gym membership for this month?

zh: 你们的半年卡有效期多久？
old_en: How long is the validity period for your six-month card?
new_en: How long is your six-month card valid?

zh: 我想参加瑜伽课，怎么报名？
old_en: I want to join the yoga class, how do I sign up?
new_en: I want to join the yoga class. How do I sign up?

zh: 这个星期的舞蹈课什么时候开始报名？
old_en: When does registration for this week's dance class start?
new_en: When does registration for this week's dance class start?

zh: 这个跑步机怎么用？
old_en: How do you use this treadmill?
new_en: How do you use this treadmill?

zh: 你能教我一下怎么使用哑铃吗？
old_en: Can you show me how to use the dumbbells?
new_en: Can you teach me how to use the dumbbells?

zh: 我想练手臂，你们有什么推荐的课程吗？
old_en: I want to work on my arms, do you have any course recommendations?
new_en: I want to work on my arms. Do you have any recommended classes?

zh: 我想增肌，可以给我建议吗？
old_en: I want to build muscle, can you give me some advice?
new_en: I want to build muscle. Can you give me some advice?

zh: 昨天做了重量训练，今天肌肉好酸。
old_en: I did weight training yesterday, my muscles are sore today.
new_en: I did weight training yesterday, so my muscles are sore today.

zh: 今天跑了五公里，现在好累。
old_en: I ran five kilometers today, I feel really tired now.
new_en: I ran five kilometers today, and I am really tired now.

zh: 教练，这周的私教课什么时候有空？
old_en: Coach, when do you have availability this week for private training?
new_en: Coach, when are you free for private lessons this week?

zh: 我想请教练帮我制订锻炼计划。
old_en: I want to hire a coach to help me make a workout plan.
new_en: I want the coach to help me create a workout plan.

zh: 更衣室要记得锁门，安全第一。
old_en: Remember to lock the door when you leave the changing room, safety first.
new_en: Remember to lock the changing room door; safety first.

zh: 用完更衣室记得清理一下，保持卫生。
old_en: Clean up after using the changing room to keep it clean.
new_en: Please clean up after using the changing room to keep it hygienic.

zh: 最近每天跑步，感觉体重轻了一些。
old_en: I've been running every day lately, and I feel my weight has gone down a bit.
new_en: I've been running every day lately and feel a bit lighter.

zh: 坚持健身两周了，肌肉线条明显了。
old_en: I've been working out for two weeks now, and I can see my muscle definition.
new_en: I've worked out for two weeks and my muscles are more defined.

zh: 运动时不小心扭到脚了。
old_en: I sprained my ankle while exercising.
new_en: I accidentally sprained my ankle while exercising.

zh: 刚才做深蹲时膝盖疼。
old_en: My knees hurt when I was doing squats just now.
new_en: My knees hurt when I did squats just now.

zh: 我们下周一起去游泳吧。
old_en: Let's go swimming together next week.
new_en: Let's go swimming together next week.

zh: 明天一起去健身房跑步。
old_en: Let's go running at the gym together tomorrow.
new_en: Let's go running at the gym together tomorrow.
